rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。constructor、pre_predict、待機transaction検査は個別の規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the constructor and protected helpers plus read/write hooks retain their subordinate contracts and unresolved conditions.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。constructor、protected helper、read／write hookは下位契約と未解決条件を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces abstract and physical operation descriptors and their role at adapter boundaries. Related item and conversion requirements decompose selected observable contracts; bus-width/endianness conditions in 19.1.2 remain separately open.
rationale.ja: 概要は抽象／物理operation descriptorとadapter境界での役割を導入する。関連item／変換要求は選択した観測可能契約を分解し、19.1.2のbus幅／endianness条件は別に未完とする。

rationale.en: The overview describes a bus-independent transaction and a map handle for optional custom translation. The related descriptor/map obligations cover those selected properties without requiring a new custom-translation algorithm or asserting every content field.
rationale.ja: 概要はbus-independent transactionと任意のcustom変換用map handleを説明する。関連descriptor／map義務は選択した性質を扱い、新たなcustom変換algorithmや全内容fieldを要求しない。

rationale.en: The overview names conversion between generic register operations and bus accesses. Selected conversion obligations are decomposed under the adapter methods rather than duplicated as an additional stream algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric register operationとbus accessの変換を示す。選択した変換義務はadapter methodへ分解し、追加のstream algorithmとして重複計数しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the generic-to-bus conversion interface; concrete declaration and selected reg2bus/bus2reg contracts are decomposed by related requirements. It does not resolve the separate parent_sequence do_clone wording.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric-to-bus変換interfaceを導入する。具象宣言と選択したreg2bus／bus2reg契約は関連要求へ分解する。別のparent_sequenceのdo_clone文言は解決しない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies the generic-payload adapter interface. Its inheritance and selected conversions are decomposed by the related requirements; absolute one-way byte/lane interpretation remains open.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric-payload adapter interfaceを示す。継承と選択した変換は関連要求へ分解し、片方向の絶対byte／lane解釈は未完に残す。

rationale.en: The overview describes bus-observation-based prediction subject to access policy, excluding memories. The related mirror/publication and nonregister-ignore requirements decompose these obligations; this is not a second all-policy conformance claim.
rationale.ja: 概要はaccess policyに従うbus観測による予測とmemoryの除外を説明する。関連mirror／公開とnonregister無視の要求へ義務を分解し、全policy適合を重ねて主張しない。

rationale.en: The overview permits custom backdoors when default pure-SystemVerilog/DPI access is unsuitable. Related original-storage extensions exercise this customization route without requiring a physical HDL target or interpreting the native HDL API contracts.
rationale.ja: 概要は既定のpure-SystemVerilog／DPI accessが適さない場合のcustom backdoorを認める。関連する独自記憶域の拡張でこのcustom経路を検査し、物理HDL対象の必須化やnative HDL API契約の解釈はしない。

rationale.en: Variables heading only; model, adapter and upstream sequencer roles remain in their subordinate clauses.
rationale.ja: Variables見出しのみ。model、adapter、upstream sequencerの役割は下位条項に残る。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; constructor, repeated body and direct-item execution have separate subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。constructor、反復body、直接item実行は下位の個別契約にある。

rationale.en: Variables heading only; rw_info and sequencer retain their own subordinate obligations.
rationale.ja: Variables見出しのみ。rw_infoとsequencerは下位の個別義務を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the HDL support routines retain separate success/failure and force/release contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。HDL support routineは成功／失敗、force／releaseの個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the register stimulus base classes. Related test, translation and frontdoor requirements decompose selected roles without adding an independent stimulus-generation algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はregister stimulus基底classを導入する。関連test／translation／frontdoor要求は選択した役割を分解し、独立したstimulus生成algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: The overview distinguishes user test and layered translation roles and permits register access outside this base class. Related requirements decompose selected convenience/model use and actual translation. Optional use is not a new requirement to derive every register stimulus from this class.
rationale.ja: 概要はuser testとlayered translationの役割を区別し、この基底外からのregister accessも認める。関連要求は選択した便利API／model利用と実translationを分解する。任意利用を、全register stimulusがこのclassから派生すべき新しい義務とはしない。

rationale.en: The overview describes the common convenience delegation and implicit parent convention; the ten child APIs and related context requirements retain those obligations and their separate defaults. No additional unnamed convenience method or separate algorithm is introduced.
rationale.ja: 概要は共通の便利委譲と暗黙parent規約を説明し、10の子APIと関連context要求が、その義務と別々の既定値を保持する。名前のない追加便利methodや別algorithmは導入しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces custom physical-access facade sequences, including nonlinear or unmapped mechanisms. Related inheritance and original custom-frontdoor access requirements cover selected observable roles; physical DUT implementations and arbitrary nonlinear protocols remain separate.
rationale.ja: 概要は非線形／unmapped機構を含むcustom物理access facade sequenceを導入する。関連継承と独自custom-frontdoor access要求が選択した観測可能な役割を扱い、物理DUT実装と任意非線形protocolは別に残す。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the HDL backdoor implementation interface and the compile-time opt-out. Related parameter and actual check/deposit/read requirements decompose selected contracts. The no-DPI parameter probes do not certify HDL execution, and untested force/release clauses remain open.
rationale.ja: 概要はHDL backdoor実装interfaceとcompile時の無効化を導入する。関連parameterと実際のcheck／deposit／read要求が選択した契約を分解する。no-DPI parameter probeはHDL実行を認定せず、未検査のforce／release条項は未完に残す。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; event-base construction, waits and state/count queries retain their own subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。event-base生成、待機、状態／件数照会は下位の個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; typed-event construction, trigger and data APIs remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。型付きeventの生成、trigger、data APIは個別規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; callback construction and pre/post-trigger contracts remain in child clauses.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。callback生成とpre／post-trigger契約は子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; barrier construction, threshold, wait, reset and count contracts remain separate.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。barrier生成、threshold、wait、reset、count契約は個別に残る。

rationale.en: Pool-classes heading only, followed directly by the individual pool clauses; it adds no independent operation.
rationale.ja: Pool classes見出しのみで個別pool条項が直後に続き、独立の操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; event-pool methods retain their own contracts and unresolved get_global declaration/prose issue.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。event-pool methodは個別契約とget_global宣言／本文の未解決点を保持する。

rationale.en: Common-methods heading only; barrier-pool methods retain their own contracts and unresolved get_global declaration/prose issue.
rationale.ja: Common methods見出しのみ。barrier-pool methodは個別契約とget_global宣言／本文の未解決点を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces event, barrier, named-pool and callback services. Related state/wait, threshold, singleton and callback requirements decompose selected roles without adding another scheduling algorithm. It does not close untested conditions.
rationale.ja: 概要はevent、barrier、名前付きpool、callback serviceを導入する。関連する状態／wait、threshold、singleton、callback要求が選択した役割を分解し、別のschedule algorithmを追加しない。未検査条件は解消しない。

rationale.en: The overview names the event base and typed derivative; selected inheritance and typed data obligations are decomposed in related declarations and getter requirements.
rationale.ja: 概要はevent基底と型付き派生型を示し、選択した継承と型付きdata義務を関連宣言／getter要求へ分解する。

rationale.en: The overview describes an abstract event wrapper with callbacks and waiter accounting. Related callback and actual-count requirements decompose selected services; this does not certify every event scheduling condition.
rationale.ja: 概要はcallbackとwaiter計数を持つ抽象event wrapperを説明する。関連callback／実件数要求が選択serviceを分解し、全event schedule条件を認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes the typed derivative and optional trigger-data type. Related declared type, scalar-value and object-handle requirements cover selected conditions without duplicating a new data transport algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要は型付き派生型と省略可能なtrigger-data型を説明する。関連する宣言型、scalar値、object handle要求が選択条件を扱い、新たなdata転送algorithmを重複させない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces derived callbacks attached to events as an alternative to waiter processes. Related declaration and pre/post-trigger requirements decompose selected observable contracts; disabled callback behavior remains a separate known difference.
rationale.ja: 概要はwaiter processに代わる、eventへ付ける派生callbackを導入する。関連宣言とpre／post-trigger要求が選択した観測可能契約を分解し、無効callback動作は別の既知差分に残る。

rationale.en: The overview describes threshold-based multi-process blocking and release. Related wait, changed-threshold and reset requirements decompose selected obligations rather than creating a second synchronization algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はthresholdに基づく複数processの待機と解放を説明する。関連wait、threshold変更、reset要求が選択義務を分解し、別の同期algorithmを作らない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies a collection of barriers; exact generic inheritance and existing keyed-creation requirements decompose the selected role, without implying a separate initial-membership rule or resolving get_global return type.
rationale.ja: 概要はbarrierの集合を示し、正確なgeneric継承と既存key生成要求が選択役割を分解する。別の初期所属規則やget_global戻り型の解決は含意しない。

rationale.en: Objection-control heading only; propagation mode, raise/drop, clear and drain retain subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Objection control見出しのみ。propagation mode、raise／drop、clear、drainは下位契約に残る。

rationale.en: Callback-hooks heading only; raised, dropped and all_dropped remain separate functions/tasks.
rationale.ja: Callback hooks見出しのみ。raised、dropped、all_droppedは個別function／taskに残る。

rationale.en: Objection-status heading only; list, event wait and source/total queries remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: Objection status見出しのみ。一覧、event待ち、source／total照会は個別規定に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; the three registered objection callback contracts remain in the child clauses.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。3つの登録objection callback契約は子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; callback construction, mode and enabled query retain separate contracts and the omitted-mode default ambiguity.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。callback生成、mode、enable照会は個別契約とmode省略値の曖昧さを保持する。

rationale.en: Common-parameters heading only; object and callback type requirements remain in the two child clauses.
rationale.ja: Common parameters見出しのみ。object／callback型要求は2つの子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Add/delete-interface heading only; registration and name-based addition/removal retain their individual obligations.
rationale.ja: Add／delete interface見出しのみ。登録と名前による追加／削除は個別義務を保持する。

rationale.en: The introduction names the objection mechanism. Related count, propagation and callback requirements decompose selected contracts without adding a distinct coordination algorithm.
rationale.ja: 導入はobjection機構を示す。関連count、propagation、callback要求は選択契約を分解し、別の協調algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: The overview identifies status coordination among components, objects and module-based participants. Related source/total and event-wait requirements cover selected roles; arbitrary participant combinations remain open.
rationale.ja: 概要はcomponent、object、module-based参加者の状態協調を示す。関連source／totalとevent待ち要求が選択役割を扱い、任意の参加者組合せは未完に残す。

rationale.en: The overview and note identify the registered objection callback type and specific-objection registration alias. Related inheritance and actual raised/drop/all-drop requirements decompose selected roles without an additional callback algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要と注記は登録objection callback型と特定objection用登録aliasを示す。関連継承と実際のraised／drop／all-drop要求へ選択役割を分解し、追加callback algorithmはない。

rationale.en: The introduction groups callback registration, management and user extension classes. Related declarations and actual registration requirements retain their separate contracts.
rationale.ja: 導入はcallback登録、管理、user拡張classをまとめ、関連宣言と実登録要求が個別契約を保持する。

rationale.en: The overview introduces the user callback base and optional virtual user hooks. Related base/type and original typed-dispatch requirements cover selected roles without requiring a specific new user hook signature.
rationale.ja: 概要はuser callback基底と任意のvirtual user hookを導入する。関連基底／型と独自の型付き委譲要求が選択役割を扱い、特定の新user hook signatureは要求しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes typed customizable hooks and valid object/callback pair registration. Related type and valid-pair dispatch requirements decompose selected roles; invalid-pair rejection and diagnostic details are not certified.
rationale.ja: 概要は型付きcustom hookと有効なobject／callback組の登録を説明する。関連型と有効組の委譲要求が選択役割を分解し、不正組の拒否や診断詳細は認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces static iterators and recommends the optional facade. Individual endpoint/next/previous obligations are decomposed by existing requirements; the recommendation adds no separate executable iterator operation.
rationale.ja: 概要はstatic iteratorと任意facadeの推奨を導入する。endpoint／next／previousの個別義務は既存要求へ分解し、推奨は別の実行iterator操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Chapter title only; TLM 1/2 declarations and methods retain subordinate obligations.
rationale.ja: 章題のみ。TLM 1／2の宣言とmethodは下位義務に残る。

rationale.en: TLM 1 section heading only, followed by the General subclause.
rationale.ja: TLM 1節の見出しのみで、General下位条項が続く。

rationale.en: Methods heading only; primitive and transport interface methods retain their child contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しのみ。primitive／transport interface methodは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: An organizing introduction pointing to port classes; it adds no independent port operation.
rationale.ja: port classを示す整理用導入であり、独立port操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: An organizing introduction pointing to implementation classes; subordinate interfaces retain their behavior.
rationale.ja: implementation classを示す整理用導入であり、動作は下位interfaceに残る。

rationale.en: An organizing introduction pointing to FIFO classes; it adds no distinct storage algorithm.
rationale.ja: FIFO classを示す整理用導入であり、別の記憶algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: Ports heading and forward pointer only; named FIFO interfaces retain their child clauses.
rationale.ja: Ports見出しと前方参照のみ。名前付きFIFO interfaceは子条項を保持する。

rationale.en: An organizing introduction pointing to built-in channel classes, without another channel operation.
rationale.ja: 組込みchannel classを示す整理用導入であり、追加channel操作はない。

rationale.en: Ports heading and forward pointer only; the named request/response interfaces retain subordinate contracts.
rationale.ja: Ports見出しと前方参照のみ。名前付き要求／応答interfaceは下位契約を保持する。

rationale.en: An organizing introduction for analysis port/export/imp classes; their declarations and writes remain separate.
rationale.ja: analysis port／export／imp classの整理用導入であり、宣言とwriteは個別に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading and pointers to constructor/write only; it introduces no additional method.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しとconstructor／writeへの参照のみで、追加methodはない。

rationale.en: The overview distinguishes TLM 1 message interfaces from TLM 2 payload/socket protocols. Related existing and new transport requirements decompose selected roles; it adds no standalone transport algorithm or all-protocol coverage.
rationale.ja: 概要はTLM 1 message interfaceとTLM 2 payload／socket protocolを区別する。関連する既存／新規transport要求が選択役割を分解し、単独transport algorithmや全protocol coverageは追加しない。

rationale.en: The overview groups blocking/nonblocking/combined interfaces, compatible supersets and port/export/imp roles. Actual FIFO subsets, existing indexed implementations and related method requirements decompose selected conditions; arbitrary compatibility and concurrency remain open.
rationale.ja: 概要はblocking／nonblocking／combined interface、互換superset、port／export／impの役割をまとめる。実FIFO subset、既存index付きimplementation、関連method要求が選択条件を分解し、任意互換性と並行性は未完に残る。

rationale.en: The overview groups the unidirectional primitive and analysis interfaces. Related put/get/peek and broadcast requirements retain their observable method contracts rather than introducing another operation.
rationale.ja: 概要はunidirectional primitiveとanalysis interfaceをまとめる。関連put／get／peekとbroadcast要求が観測可能method契約を保持し、別の操作を導入しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes put as delivery rather than execution completion. Actual FIFO delivery and blocking-put requirements decompose that selected interface contract; no downstream execution algorithm is prescribed.
rationale.ja: 概要はputを実行完了ではなく配送として説明する。実FIFO配送とblocking-put要求が選択interface契約を分解し、下流実行algorithmは規定しない。

rationale.en: The overview distinguishes consuming get from retaining peek. Related method and actual object-head availability requirements decompose the same obligation without duplicating a new retrieval API.
rationale.ja: 概要は消費するgetと保持するpeekを区別する。関連methodと実object-head availability要求へ同じ義務を分解し、新retrieval APIとして重複させない。

rationale.en: The overview groups bidirectional transport and independent master/slave request/response interfaces. Related transport and channel direction requirements cover selected roles; no additional generic operation is defined.
rationale.ja: 概要は双方向transportと独立したmaster／slave要求・応答interfaceをまとめる。関連transportとchannel方向要求が選択役割を扱い、追加generic操作は定義しない。

rationale.en: The overview couples a request/response in one transport call and permits different types. Related explicit-type sequential forwarding requirements decompose selected conditions; concurrent arbitration/order is not certified.
rationale.ja: 概要は1 transport呼出しで要求／応答を結び、異なる型を認める。関連する明示型の逐次転送要求が選択条件を分解し、並行arbitration／順序は認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview defines master/slave direction and independent request/response calls. Existing direction, independent queue and blocked-response requirements retain these selected contracts rather than a new coupled transport algorithm.
rationale.ja: 概要はmaster／slave方向と独立した要求・応答呼出しを定める。既存の方向、独立queue、応答待ち要求が選択契約を保持し、新たな結合transport algorithmはない。

rationale.en: The overview describes primitive/combined transaction interfaces and compatible method binding. Related declarations, FIFO export methods and actual transport forwarding decompose selected contracts; all primitive/type combinations remain separate.
rationale.ja: 概要はprimitive／combined transaction interfaceと互換method bindingを説明する。関連宣言、FIFO export method、実transport転送が選択契約を分解し、全primitive／型組合せは別に残る。

rationale.en: The overview describes the FIFO base, public interfaces and default methods. Related base construction and actual export-method requirements decompose selected contracts; default unimplemented method behavior is not certified.
rationale.ja: 概要はFIFO基底、公開interface、既定methodを説明する。関連基底生成と実export-method要求が選択契約を分解し、未実装の既定method動作は認定しない。

rationale.en: The overview describes independent typed request/response FIFOs of configurable size. Existing queue-direction/order and zero-size requirements decompose selected roles; default parameter and constructor obligations remain separately open.
rationale.ja: 概要は設定可能sizeの独立した型付き要求／応答FIFOを説明する。既存queue方向／順序とsize 0要求が選択役割を分解し、parameter既定値とconstructor義務は別に未完とする。

rationale.en: The overview describes analysis broadcast to all subscribers. The existing specific write and related generic-interface broadcast requirements decompose the same contract; constructor/type declarations remain separately specified.
rationale.ja: 概要は全subscriberへのanalysis broadcastを説明する。既存の固有writeと関連generic-interface broadcast要求が同じ契約を分解し、constructor／型宣言は個別規定に残る。

rationale.en: TLM 2 section heading only; its introduction, interface and payload/socket contracts remain subordinate.
rationale.ja: TLM 2節の見出しのみ。導入、interface、payload／socket契約は下位に残る。

rationale.en: Enumeration grouping heading only; named phase and status contracts remain in the two child clauses.
rationale.ja: enumのグループ見出しのみ。名前付きphase／status契約は2つの子条項に残る。

rationale.en: Grouping statement for constants/enums only; the two child enum clauses retain their actual type/value contracts.
rationale.ja: 定数／enumをまとめる記述のみ。実際の型／値契約は2つの子enum条項に残る。

rationale.en: The overview locates generic payloads, ports/exports/imps and two-direction sockets. Related existing actual forwarding and new interface-declaration requirements retain those roles; this overview introduces no additional transport operation.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric payload、port／export／imp、双方向socketの位置付けを示す。関連する既存の実転送と新interface宣言要求が役割を保持し、概要は追加transport操作を導入しない。

rationale.en: The overview characterizes the generic bus transaction and states its default use in transport interfaces. The actual default interface declaration and inherited payload members retain selected obligations; physical bus interpretation remains in subordinate member clauses.
rationale.ja: 概要はgeneric bus transactionとtransport interfaceでの既定利用を説明する。実際の既定interface宣言と継承payload memberが選択義務を保持し、物理bus解釈は下位member条項に残る。

rationale.en: The overview describes a reusable memory-mapped transaction and its sequence-item inheritance. The specific class-declaration requirement now directly checks that inheritance; target data/command semantics remain in the member clauses.
rationale.ja: 概要は再利用可能なmemory-mapped transactionとsequence-item継承を説明する。固有class宣言要求が継承を直接検査し、target data／command意味はmember条項に残る。

rationale.en: Methods heading and forward references only; the extension-base constructor and type-key methods retain their own contracts.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しと前方参照のみ。extension-base constructorとtype-key methodは固有契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods heading and forward references only; constructor and ID contracts remain subordinate.
rationale.ja: Methods見出しと前方参照のみ。constructorとID契約は下位に残る。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods grouping and forward references only; socket constructors and connect retain their child contracts, including printed wording conflicts.
rationale.ja: Methodsのグループと前方参照のみ。印刷文言の矛盾を含め、socket constructorとconnectは子契約を保持する。

rationale.en: One organizing sentence defining the following port-class section; actual type and transport duties remain in its three children.
rationale.ja: 後続port-class節を示す整理用1文であり、実際の型／transport義務は3つの子条項に残る。

rationale.en: One organizing sentence defining the export-class section; actual type and forwarding duties remain subordinate.
rationale.ja: export-class節を示す整理用1文であり、実際の型／転送義務は下位に残る。

rationale.en: Methods is a grouping heading only; subscriber construction and the required write interface are specified in its two method children and remain explicit requirements.
rationale.ja: Methodsは分類見出しだけであり、subscriber生成と必須write interfaceは下位method 2条項に規定され、明示要求として残す。

rationale.en: Reporting classes is the chapter heading; the concrete reporting duties are specified in its subclauses.
rationale.ja: Reporting classesは章見出しで、具体的reporting義務は下位条項に規定される。

rationale.en: The overview explains reporter-to-handler-to-server delegation and configuration/filtering. Linked concrete defaults, configuration and pipeline requirements retain those obligations; this adds no exclusion or completeness claim.
rationale.ja: 概要はreporterからhandler、serverへの委譲と設定／filterを説明する。関連する具体的default、設定、pipeline要求で義務を保持し、除外や網羅の主張は加えない。

rationale.en: Reporting groups four following report-entry APIs; it adds no separate declaration or behavior.
rationale.ja: Reportingは後続report-entry API 4つを整理する見出しで、別の宣言や動作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Verbosity configuration is a grouping heading; getter/setter duties are in its four children.
rationale.ja: Verbosity configurationは整理見出しで、getter／setter義務は下位4条項にある。

rationale.en: Action configuration is a grouping heading; the query and setter declarations are in its two children.
rationale.ja: Action configurationは整理見出しで、照会とsetterの宣言は下位2条項にある。

rationale.en: File configuration is a grouping heading; effective-file and configuration duties are in its two children.
rationale.ja: File configurationは整理見出しで、有効fileと設定の義務は下位2条項にある。

rationale.en: The Report server heading and one introductory sentence name the following server class group without a separate operational duty.
rationale.ja: Report server見出しと導入1文は後続server class群を示し、独立した操作義務を持たない。

rationale.en: Common methods and its introduction group the subsequent report-server methods; individual signatures and behavior remain explicit requirements.
rationale.ja: Common methodsと導入は後続report-server methodを整理し、個別signatureと動作は明示要求として保持する。

rationale.en: Methods groups the policy methods that follow; it has no separate declaration or behavior.
rationale.ja: Methodsは後続policy methodを整理し、独立した宣言や動作を持たない。

rationale.en: Methods groups the printer constructor and default-policy wrappers below it.
rationale.ja: Methodsは下位のprinter constructorとdefault-policy wrapperを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods for printer usage is a grouping heading; each printing API is specified in a child clause.
rationale.ja: Methods for printer usageは整理見出しで、各印字APIは下位条項に規定される。

rationale.en: Methods for printer subtyping groups emit and flush without a separate operational rule.
rationale.ja: Methods for printer subtypingは独立した操作規則を追加せずemitとflushを整理する。

rationale.en: The heading and introductory sentence organize the following common printer controls; their actual defaults and behavior remain explicit child requirements.
rationale.ja: 見出しと導入文は後続の共通printer controlを整理し、実際の既定値と動作は下位の明示要求として残す。

rationale.en: Methods is the element API grouping heading; field and constructor obligations are in its children.
rationale.ja: Methodsはelement API整理見出しで、fieldとconstructor義務は下位にある。

rationale.en: Methods groups the proxy constructor and child query below it.
rationale.ja: Methodsは下位proxy constructorとchild照会を整理する。

rationale.en: Methods groups the table-printer constructor, type query and default-instance accessors.
rationale.ja: Methodsはtable-printer constructor、type照会、default-instance accessorを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods groups the tree-printer constructor, type query and default-instance accessors.
rationale.ja: Methodsはtree-printer constructor、type照会、default-instance accessorを整理する。

rationale.en: The configuration heading and one organizing sentence introduce the two numbered controls, whose indentation and separator duties remain normative requirements.
rationale.ja: 設定見出しと整理文1つは番号付きcontrol 2つを導入し、indentとseparatorの義務は規範的要求に保持する。

rationale.en: Methods groups the line-printer constructor, type query and default-instance accessors.
rationale.ja: Methodsはline-printer constructor、type照会、default-instance accessorを整理する。

rationale.en: The overview explains the standard proxy as the way to traverse implementation-specific printer-element children, with class/array examples. The existing child/push/pop requirements preserve that behavior; it does not prescribe private representation or certify all rendering.
rationale.ja: 概要はclass／array例とともに、実装固有のprinter-element childを辿る標準proxyを説明する。既存child／push／pop要求で動作を保持し、非公開表現を規定せず、全renderingも認定しない。

rationale.en: This introduction describes the element as the string-form data structure consumed by emit. The existing attribute requirements and the linked actual structured emitter preserve those concrete duties without a second copy of the same renderer obligation. The class declaration and field methods remain explicit partial requirements; this is not a rendering-completeness claim.
rationale.ja: 導入はelementをemitが消費する文字列形式のdata構造として説明する。既存属性要求と実際の構造emitterへの対応で具体的義務を保持し、同じrenderer義務を重複追加しない。class宣言とfield methodは明示した部分要求に保持し、rendering網羅を主張しない。

rationale.en: Methods groups the separately numbered comparer constructor, flush, type and default-selection APIs.
rationale.ja: Methodsは個別番号付きcomparer constructor、flush、type、default選択APIを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods for comparer usage groups the individually specified comparison and result APIs.
rationale.ja: Methods for comparer usageは個々に規定された比較／結果APIを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods for comparer configuration groups recursion and type-checking controls; defaults remain in their child clauses.
rationale.ja: Methods for comparer configurationはrecursionとtype-checking controlを整理し、既定値は下位条項に残す。

rationale.en: Methods for comparer reporting control groups maximum count, verbosity and severity without an additional rule.
rationale.ja: Methods for comparer reporting controlは追加規則なしに最大数、verbosity、severityを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods for recorder configuration is the parent heading for the three specified controls.
rationale.ja: Methods for recorder configurationは規定control 3つの親見出しである。

rationale.en: Handles is a grouping heading; unique-ID and lookup duties are explicitly in its two children.
rationale.ja: Handlesは整理見出しで、unique-IDとlookup義務は下位2条項に明記される。

rationale.en: Attribute recording groups the nine individually specified public recording and attribute APIs.
rationale.ja: Attribute recordingは個々に規定された公開recording／attribute API 9つを整理する。

rationale.en: Implementation agnostic API is a heading for the callbacks and history accessor below; pure hooks remain normative child requirements.
rationale.ja: Implementation agnostic APIは下位callbackとhistory accessorの見出しで、pure hookは規範的な下位要求に残す。

rationale.en: Methods groups the numbered packer construction, flush, type and default-policy APIs.
rationale.ja: Methodsは番号付きpacker生成、flush、type、default-policy APIを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods for packer subtyping groups state assignment, retrieval and size queries; compatible-stream limitations remain in the children.
rationale.ja: Methods for packer subtypingはstate設定、取得、size照会を整理し、互換stream制限は下位に残す。

rationale.en: Packing and unpacking is the heading for the separately numbered operations, without its own additional behavior.
rationale.ja: Packing and unpackingは個別番号付き操作の見出しで、独立した追加動作を持たない。

rationale.en: Methods groups copier construction, type and default-policy helpers; it adds no separate obligation.
rationale.ja: Methodsはcopier生成、type、default-policy helperを整理し、独立した義務を追加しない。

rationale.en: Methods for copier usage groups the specified copy operation and ordered-pair history query.
rationale.ja: Methods for copier usageは規定copy操作と順序付きpair履歴照会を整理する。

rationale.en: The overview identifies the abstract common base. Abstract construction and the five declared policy base relationships remain explicit requirements; this explanatory summary does not close their method contracts.
rationale.ja: 概要はabstract共通baseを示す。abstract生成と宣言policy 5種のbase関係は明示要求に保持し、この説明概要でmethod契約を完了しない。

rationale.en: The introduction explains comparison policy, counted and retained results and the object comparison APIs. Those duties remain in linked comparison/history requirements and their partial conditions; it adds no separate result format.
rationale.ja: 導入は比較policy、計数し保持する結果、object比較APIを説明する。これらの義務はlinkした比較／履歴要求と部分条件に保持し、独立した結果formatを追加しない。

rationale.en: The introduction explains the recorder as a stream record and a recording policy. Stream identity, legal policy base and field recording stay in the related requirements; no concrete database format or constructor contract is introduced here.
rationale.ja: 導入はrecorderをstream record兼recording policyとして説明する。stream同一性、合法policy base、field recordingは関連要求に保持し、ここで具体database formatやconstructor契約を導入しない。

rationale.en: The introduction describes packing and unpacking objects under a policy. Actual object hooks, stream state and field operations remain separate partial requirements; this purpose statement does not prescribe serialized layout.
rationale.ja: 導入はpolicyによるobject pack／unpackを説明する。実object hook、stream state、field操作は独立した部分要求に残し、この目的説明は直列layoutを規定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction states the copier purpose and that policies select how copying is done. The actual hook, recursion and ownership rules stay in the linked requirements; all copy applicability is not certified by this summary assessment.
rationale.ja: 導入はcopierの目的とpolicyがcopy方法を選ぶことを説明する。実hook、再帰、所有関係の規則はlink要求に保持し、この概要分類で全copy適用条件を認定しない。

rationale.en: Types groups the allocation-mode and locality enumerations; their behavioral meanings remain separate normative clauses.
rationale.ja: Typesは割当modeとlocalityのenumを整理し、その動作上の意味は独立した規範条項に残す。

rationale.en: Methods groups manager construction and reconfiguration; it adds no independent default or operation.
rationale.ja: Methodsはmanager生成と再設定を整理し、独立した既定値や操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Memory management is the heading for reserve, request and release methods specified in its children.
rationale.ja: Memory managementは下位に規定するreserve、request、release methodの見出しである。

rationale.en: Introspection groups textual state, iteration and memory queries; each child still needs its own duties.
rationale.ja: Introspectionは状態文面、反復、memory照会を整理し、各下位条項の義務は独立に必要である。

rationale.en: Methods groups the region accessors and transfer operations without adding a separate operation.
rationale.ja: Methodsはregion accessorと転送操作を整理し、独立した操作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Variables groups configuration fields; it does not specify initial defaults or exhaust mode/locality semantics.
rationale.ja: Variablesはconfiguration fieldを整理し、初期既定値を規定せず、mode／localityの意味全体も完了しない。

rationale.en: The introduction identifies the configuration descriptor as specifying the manager memory. Concrete bytes-per-location and range duties remain linked; mode/locality behavior is still unassessed and no undocumented defaults are inferred.
rationale.ja: 導入はconfiguration descriptorがmanager memoryを指定すると説明する。具体的なlocation当たりbyte数とrange義務はlinkして保持し、mode／locality動作は未評価のまま、未記載既定値も推測しない。

rationale.en: Sequencer classes is the chapter heading; overview and numbered class contracts follow.
rationale.ja: Sequencer classesは章見出しで、概要と番号付きclass契約が続く。

rationale.en: Sequencer interface is the grouping heading for the base interface and typed connectors.
rationale.ja: Sequencer interfaceはbase interfaceと型付connectorの整理見出しである。

rationale.en: Methods groups the individually specified sequence-driver interface APIs.
rationale.ja: Methodsは個々に規定されたsequence-driver interface APIを整理する。

rationale.en: Methods groups the base sequencer constructor and operations; behavioral duties stay in children.
rationale.ja: Methodsはbase sequencer constructorと操作を整理し、動作義務は下位に保持する。

rationale.en: Responses groups the response export and retained-response query; it has no separate behavior.
rationale.ja: Responsesはresponse exportと保持response照会を整理し、独立動作を持たない。

rationale.en: Methods groups the concrete pull sequencer constructor, interface export and operations.
rationale.ja: Methodsは具象pull sequencer constructor、interface export、操作を整理する。

rationale.en: Methods groups common API, push construction and run phase; the latter algorithm remains normative.
rationale.ja: Methodsは共通API、push生成、run phaseを整理し、後者のalgorithmは規範的に保持する。

rationale.en: The overview explains arbitration among sequence-generated transactions. Concrete grant and request/driver duties remain linked and partial rather than being excluded by this description.
rationale.ja: 概要はsequence生成transaction間のarbitrationを説明する。具体的なgrantとrequest／driver義務はlinkして部分対応に保持し、この説明で除外しない。

rationale.en: The variants introduction distinguishes driver pull from sequencer push and explains sequence initiative. Corresponding request, blocking and producer-grant duties remain explicit below; typical driver examples add no mandatory class pairing.
rationale.ja: variant導入はdriver pullとsequencer pushを区別し、sequenceの開始側としての役割を説明する。対応するrequest、blocking、producer-grant義務は下位に明示し、典型driver例で必須class組合せを追加しない。

rationale.en: This paragraph points to the special pull connectors used by the sequencer/driver pair. Typed connector and transaction-handshake requirements retain that mechanism without certifying every topology.
rationale.ja: 本段落はsequencer／driver対が使う特別なpull connectorを参照する。型付connectorとtransaction-handshake要求に機構を保持し、全topologyを認定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction identifies port/export/imp roles and delegates their declarations and standard constructors to the three children. Explicit type-default conflicts remain in those partial contracts.
rationale.ja: 導入はport／export／impの役割を示し、宣言と標準constructorを下位3条項へ委ねる。明示type既定値の矛盾は部分契約に保持する。

rationale.en: The introduction explains base-sequencer flow control; the grant/send and execution operations preserve its selected behavior as separate duties. It does not settle every arbitration mode.
rationale.ja: 導入はbase sequencerのflow制御を説明し、grant／sendと実行操作で選択動作を独立義務として保持する。全arbitration modeは解決しない。

rationale.en: The introduction restates the pull variant role and typical driver use. Blocking retrieval and concrete transactions remain explicit requirements; arbitrary driver extensions are not certified.
rationale.ja: 導入はpull variantの役割と典型driver利用を再掲する。blocking取得と具象transactionは明示要求に保持し、任意driver拡張は認定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction describes push flow and driver backpressure. Continuous dispatch and blocking completion remain linked normative duties; the purpose statement adds no separate queue layout.
rationale.ja: 導入はpush flowとdriver backpressureを説明する。連続dispatchとblocking完了はlinkした規範的義務に保持し、目的説明で別のqueue layoutを追加しない。

rationale.en: Predefined component classes is a chapter heading; numbered class and interface duties follow.
rationale.ja: Predefined component classesは章見出しで、番号付きclass／interface義務が続く。

rationale.en: Common methods groups constructor, print-enable state and field-operation behavior specified in its children.
rationale.ja: Common methodsは下位で規定されるconstructor、print-enable状態、field-operation動作を整理する。

rationale.en: UVM common phases is a grouping heading; nine method contracts follow.
rationale.ja: UVM common phasesは整理見出しで、method契約9つが続く。

rationale.en: Domain methods is a grouping heading; set/get/define duties remain in the three children.
rationale.ja: Domain methodsは整理見出しで、set／get／define義務は下位3条項に保持する。

rationale.en: Agent methods groups construction and activity queries without adding separate behavior.
rationale.ja: Agent methodsは別の動作を加えず生成とactivity照会を整理する。

rationale.en: Pull driver ports groups the independently declared request and response endpoints.
rationale.ja: Pull driver portsは独立に宣言されたrequest／response endpointを整理する。

rationale.en: Push driver ports groups the request export and response port; default-put and transport duties stay below.
rationale.ja: Push driver portsはrequest exportとresponse portを整理し、既定put／transport義務は下位に保持する。

rationale.en: The hierarchy introduction explains topology access; child lookup and full-name duties remain explicit below.
rationale.ja: hierarchy導入はtopologyアクセスを説明し、child lookupとfull-name義務は下位に明示保持する。

rationale.en: The introduction names the suspension/resumption extension points. Their methods require user protocol implementations, retained as selected public dispatch duties rather than a generic library algorithm.
rationale.ja: 導入は停止／再開の拡張点を示す。methodが要求するuser protocol実装は共通library algorithmとせず選択公開dispatch義務に保持する。

rationale.en: The introduction motivates configurable topology/state. Matching resources, field operations and automatic-build selection remain explicit requirements; this description adds no separate configuration algorithm.
rationale.ja: 導入は設定可能なtopology／状態の目的を説明する。resource一致、field operation、自動build選択は明示要求に保持し、本説明で別の設定algorithmを加えない。

rationale.en: The recording introduction identifies component-level transaction observation. Concrete timing, stream and property-recording duties remain below; application-specific error/event recording is still open.
rationale.ja: recording導入はcomponent単位のtransaction観測を説明する。具体的なtime、stream、property記録義務は下位に保持し、application固有のerror／event記録は未完了である。

rationale.en: The environment introduction describes hierarchical reuse. Constructor and component-base contracts remain explicit; it mandates no fixed topology or contents.
rationale.ja: environment導入は階層的再利用を説明する。constructorとcomponent-base契約は明示保持し、固定topology／内容を必須にしない。

rationale.en: The agent introduction recommends the distinguishing base type. The declared type and activity contracts remain explicit rather than certifying arbitrary agent implementations.
rationale.ja: agent導入は区別可能なbase型を推奨する。宣言typeとactivity契約を明示保持し、任意agent実装を認定しない。

rationale.en: The monitor introduction recommends its distinguishing base type and explains future inherited features; it adds no mandatory monitor protocol.
rationale.ja: monitor導入は区別可能なbase型を推奨し、将来の継承featureを説明する。必須monitor protocolを追加しない。

rationale.en: The scoreboard introduction recommends its distinguishing base type and explains future inheritance; no scoreboard algorithm is specified here.
rationale.ja: scoreboard導入は区別可能なbase型を推奨し将来の継承を説明する。ここでscoreboard algorithmを規定しない。

rationale.en: The pull-driver introduction explains initiative and typical endpoint wiring. Typed endpoints and real request acknowledgement stay explicit; typical connections are not made mandatory for unused response ports.
rationale.ja: pull-driver導入は開始側と典型endpoint接続を説明する。型付endpointと実request acknowledgeは明示保持し、未使用response portの典型接続を必須にしない。

rationale.en: The push-driver introduction explains passive receipt and typical connections. Default-put override and blocking completion remain explicit; an unused response port is not required to be connected.
rationale.ja: push-driver導入は受動受信と典型接続を説明する。既定put overrideとblocking完了は明示保持し、未使用response portの接続を必須にしない。

rationale.en: The overview enumerates inherited hierarchy, phasing, reporting, recording and factory interfaces. Their selected normative duties remain explicit in linked children/convenience APIs; no entire interface is excluded or certified complete.
rationale.ja: 概要は継承hierarchy・phasing・reporting・recording・factory interfaceを列挙する。選択規範義務はlinkした下位／便宜APIへ明示保持し、interface全体を除外／完了認定しない。

rationale.en: The objection introduction identifies component hooks into the objection mechanism; raised/dropped/all-dropped dispatch stays in the three concrete duties. The printed all_dropped function-versus-task conflict remains partial rather than being discarded.
rationale.ja: objection導入はobjection機構へのcomponent hookを示し、raised／dropped／all-dropped dispatchは具体的3義務に保持する。印刷all_droppedのfunction／task食違いは破棄せず部分対応に残す。

rationale.en: The paragraph points to the factory and hierarchical-report convenience interfaces. Their public calls, scope and effective report behavior remain explicit in D.2 duties; this does not close every inherited API or application topology.
rationale.ja: 本段落はfactory／階層report便宜interfaceを参照する。公開call・scope・有効report動作はD.2義務に明示保持し、全継承APIやapplication topologyを完了しない。

rationale.en: The introduction explains convenience access and recommends wrappers; six numbered methods retain the concrete API duties. Preferred usage adds no mandatory wrapper-only restriction, and the printed create_object equivalent-call arity remains unresolved.
rationale.ja: 導入は便宜アクセスを説明してwrapperを推奨し、番号付き6 methodに具体的API義務を保持する。推奨利用からwrapper専用の必須制約を追加せず、印刷create_object等価callの引数数は未解決に保持する。

rationale.en: The chapter explains database, stream and recorder roles in a consistent application-specific recording API. Selected concrete connection, stream and recorder duties remain explicit below; no backend format is standardized here.
rationale.ja: 本章は一貫したapplication固有記録APIのdatabase／stream／recorder役割を説明する。選択した具体的接続・stream・recorder義務は下位に明示保持し、ここでbackend書式を標準化しない。

rationale.en: The introduction requires a concrete database implementation and explains backend abstraction. The explicit virtual declaration, negative construction and implementation hooks retain that requirement without assuming a database format.
rationale.ja: 導入は具象database実装とbackend抽象化を説明する。明示virtual宣言、生成禁止、implementation hookにその要求を保持し、database書式を仮定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction identifies an abstract stream implementation inside a database. Its declared abstract type and database/stream metadata duties remain explicit; application backend details are not universal oracles.
rationale.ja: 導入はdatabase内のabstract stream実装を示す。宣言abstract型とdatabase／stream metadata義務を明示保持し、application backend詳細を普遍的oracleにしない。

rationale.en: The paragraph restates the closed-stream open-recorder gate specified in 7.2.5.1. The existing explicit guard requirement and its unopened/open/closed observations retain the normative behavior; this classification does not discard it.
rationale.ja: 本段落は7.2.5.1のclosed-stream open-recorder gateを再掲する。既存の明示guard要求とunopened／open／closed観測へ規範動作を保持し、この分類で破棄しない。

rationale.en: The introduction explains compile-time link type identification. Concrete typed roles and database dispatch retain the selected mechanism without imposing arbitrary relation-name strings or backend semantics.
rationale.ja: 導入はcompile時のlink型識別を説明する。具象型roleとdatabase dispatchに選択機構を保持し、任意relation-name stringやbackend意味を課さない。

rationale.en: The link-base introduction describes a two-object relation and typed extensions. Endpoint setters/getters and nominal base contracts retain this API without a separate relation algorithm.
rationale.ja: link-base導入は2 objectのrelationと型付拡張を説明する。endpoint setter／getterと名目的base契約にAPIを保持し、別のrelation algorithmを追加しない。

rationale.en: The paragraph names the parent/child relation role. Its concrete type and prefilled endpoint helper remain explicit; the paragraph adds no mandatory database interpretation.
rationale.ja: 本段落はparent／child relation役割を示す。具象型とprefilled endpoint helperを明示保持し、必須database解釈を追加しない。

rationale.en: The paragraph names the cause/effect relation role. Its concrete type and prefilled endpoint helper remain explicit without a new backend causality algorithm.
rationale.ja: 本段落はcause／effect relation役割を示す。具象型とprefilled endpoint helperを明示保持し、新backend因果algorithmを加えない。

rationale.en: The paragraph names the generic related relation role. Its concrete type and prefilled helper remain explicit rather than standardizing application relation semantics.
rationale.ja: 本段落は一般related relation役割を示す。具象型とprefilled helperを明示保持し、application relation意味を標準化しない。

rationale.en: The iterator introduction explains context-specific callback traversal and gives typical usage. Default declaration and explicit first/last/next/prev/context duties remain below; the example is not a mandatory implementation.
rationale.ja: iterator導入はcontext単位callback走査と典型利用を説明する。既定宣言と明示first／last／next／prev／context義務は下位に保持し、例を必須実装にしない。

rationale.en: This introduction points to convenience interfaces for components. Factory, live reporting and hierarchical recording calls remain explicit duties rather than a separate additional interface algorithm.
rationale.ja: 本導入はcomponent便宜interfaceを参照する。factory、実reporting、階層recording callを明示義務に保持し、別の追加interface algorithmを作らない。

rationale.en: The annex title/introduction organizes convenience classes, interfaces and methods; numbered contracts retain their behavior.
rationale.ja: 付録見出し／導入は便宜class・interface・methodを整理し、番号付き契約に動作を保持する。

rationale.en: Methods is a grouping heading for six explicitly specified iterator operations.
rationale.ja: Methodsは明示規定されたiterator操作6つの整理見出しである。

rationale.en: Callback typedefs introduces convenience aliases; exact type obligations remain in the numbered declarations.
rationale.ja: Callback typedefsは便宜aliasを導入し、正確なtype義務は番号付き宣言に保持する。

rationale.en: The register-callback typedef grouping points to the twelve exact declarations and existing callback interface; it adds no independent behavior.
rationale.ja: register-callback typedefの整理は12の正確な宣言と既存callback interfaceを参照し、独立動作を追加しない。

rationale.en: The introduction identifies block-level named access wrappers. Four numbered write/read register/memory duties retain lookup, forwarding, status and debug-only behavior explicitly; no other access method is silently excluded.
rationale.ja: 導入はblock単位の名前アクセスwrapperを示す。番号付き4つのregister／memory write／read義務にlookup、転送、status、debug専用動作を明示保持し、他のaccess methodを黙って除外しない。

rationale.en: Others is an explicit cross-reference to D.3 convenience access methods. Their concrete contracts remain in the named register/memory wrapper requirements; this reference adds no independent access algorithm.
rationale.ja: OthersはD.3便宜access methodへの明示参照である。具体的契約は名前によるregister／memory wrapper要求に保持し、この参照で独立access algorithmを加えない。

rationale.en: The block introduction identifies a design-hierarchy abstraction containing registers, register files, memories, child blocks and physical-interface maps. Concrete constructor, configuration, enumeration, map, access and backdoor contracts remain under their numbered clauses. This architectural context creates no additional independent transfer algorithm and excludes none of those obligations.
rationale.ja: block導入はregister、register file、memory、子block、物理interface mapを含む設計階層抽象を示す。具体的な構築、設定、列挙、map、アクセス、backdoor契約は各番号付き条項へ保持する。この構成の文脈は独立した転送algorithmを加えず、それらの義務を除外しない。

rationale.en: The backdoor introduction distinguishes direct interaction with the hardware representation from frontdoor bus-interface access. The selected user-storage controls exercise public backdoor selection without claiming physical HDL transport; kinds and concrete get/set/path obligations remain explicitly decomposed. The definition adds no separate implementation algorithm or exclusion.
rationale.ja: backdoor導入はhardware表現との直接相互作用とfrontdoor bus-interfaceアクセスを区別する。選択user-storage controlは物理HDL transportを主張せず公開backdoor選択を実行し、kindと具体的get／set／path義務を明示分解して保持する。定義は別実装algorithmや除外を加えない。

rationale.en: The map introduction describes collections of registers/memories associated with physical interfaces, hierarchical map composition and creation through the owning block API. Concrete ownership, creation, composition, membership, introspection and bus settings retain their numbered duties. This architectural context adds no independent transfer algorithm and removes none of those obligations.
rationale.ja: map導入は物理interfaceに関連するregister／memory集合、階層map合成、所有block APIによる生成を説明する。具体的な所有、生成、合成、member、照会、bus設定は各番号付き義務へ保持する。この構成の文脈は独立転送algorithmを加えず、義務を除去しない。

rationale.en: Bus access is a grouping heading immediately followed by five numbered auto-predict, read-check and transaction-order policy methods. The heading has no separate declaration or behavioral condition; the individual method obligations remain in their own clauses and are not certified complete.
rationale.ja: Bus accessは直後に5つのauto-predict、read-check、transaction-order policy methodが続く分類見出しである。見出し自体に別宣言や動作条件はなく、各method義務を各条項へ保持し、完了したとは認定しない。

rationale.en: The register-file introduction describes a repeated collection of register files and registers. Concrete construction, ownership, nesting and HDL-path contracts remain under their numbered clauses, including selected file placement/object views; the architectural definition adds no independent access algorithm or exclusion.
rationale.ja: register-file導入はregister fileとregisterの反復集合を説明する。具体的な構築、所有、入れ子、HDL path契約は各番号付き条項へ保持し、選択file配置／object viewも含む。この構成定義は独立access algorithmや除外を加えない。

rationale.en: The register introduction identifies fields accessed as one entity and permits multiple maps with independent rights/policies. Concrete fields, map associations, model access and bus operations remain explicitly decomposed; this architectural description does not itself specify another transfer algorithm or close those conditions.
rationale.ja: register導入は1実体としてアクセスするfieldと、独立rights／policyを持つ複数mapを示す。具体的なfield、map関連、modelアクセス、bus操作は明示分解して保持し、この構成説明自体は別転送algorithmを規定せず条件を完了しない。

rationale.en: Methods is a grouping heading before the constructor, configuration, offset, transaction-order and unregister declarations. It has no separate declaration or behavioral condition; each numbered child remains independently subject to decomposition.
rationale.ja: Methodsはconstructor、設定、offset、transaction-order、unregister宣言の前の分類見出しである。別宣言や動作条件はなく、各番号付き子条項を独立に分解対象へ残す。

rationale.en: Introspection groups the following register query declarations without adding a separate query algorithm or condition. Their numbered contracts remain partial obligations.
rationale.ja: Introspectionは後続register照会宣言を分類し、別照会algorithmや条件を加えない。番号付き契約は部分義務として残す。

rationale.en: Access groups the model-value, reset, physical-access, prediction and busy APIs. The heading adds no independent behavior; all numbered access duties remain candidates and are not certified complete.
rationale.ja: Accessはmodel値、reset、物理アクセス、予測、busy APIを分類する。見出しは独立動作を加えず、全番号付きaccess義務を候補へ保持して完了とは認定しない。

rationale.en: Chapter heading introducing phasing; detailed behavior follows in numbered subclauses.
rationale.ja: phasingを導入する章見出しであり、具体的動作は下位の番号付き条項に続く。

rationale.en: Grouping heading for definition, context and state; the following three subclauses contain the behavior.
rationale.ja: definition、context、stateの分類見出しであり、続く3下位条項が動作を記述する。

rationale.en: Methods heading organizing the phase constructor and iteration APIs without additional behavior.
rationale.ja: phase constructorとiteration APIを整理するMethods見出しで、別の動作は追加しない。

rationale.en: State-access API grouping heading; the following getter/search clauses provide its behaviors.
rationale.ja: state参照APIの分類見出しで、続くgetter／search条項に動作を記述する。

rationale.en: Callback grouping heading; function and task proxy duties follow separately.
rationale.ja: callbackの分類見出しで、functionとtask proxyの義務が別々に続く。

rationale.en: Schedule API grouping heading; graph mutation and queries are specified below it.
rationale.ja: schedule APIの分類見出しで、graph変更と照会を下位に規定する。

rationale.en: Descriptor methods heading, followed by current/previous/target query clauses.
rationale.ja: descriptor methodの見出しで、current／previous／target照会条項が続く。

rationale.en: Callback methods heading, followed by constructor and state-change callback.
rationale.ja: callback methodの見出しで、constructorとstate-change callbackが続く。

rationale.en: Domain methods heading; construction, enumeration, insertion and jumping follow.
rationale.ja: domain methodの見出しで、生成、列挙、挿入、jumpが続く。

rationale.en: Bottom-up methods heading with no behavior apart from its three method clauses.
rationale.ja: bottom-up method見出しで、3個のmethod条項以外の動作を追加しない。

rationale.en: Task-phase methods heading with constructor/traversal/execute detailed below.
rationale.ja: task phaseのmethod見出しで、constructor／traversal／executeを下位に記述する。

rationale.en: Top-down methods heading with no independent behavior beyond its three methods.
rationale.ja: top-down method見出しで、3個のmethod以外の独立動作を持たない。

rationale.en: The overview introduces automated component phasing. Linked traversal requirements observe a selected mechanism; automation of every schedule remains a partial audit, not an exclusion.
rationale.ja: 概要はcomponentの自動phasingを導入する。関連する走査要求が選択した仕組みを観測するが、全scheduleの自動処理は部分監査として残し除外しない。

rationale.en: The hierarchy description relates singleton definitions and graph-node state/context, already separated by the linked drafts. Concurrent-domain independence and all implementation variants remain open.
rationale.ja: 階層の説明はsingleton定義とgraph nodeのstate／contextを関連付け、関連draftで分けて扱う。並行domainの独立性と全implementation変種は残る。

rationale.en: This is a cross-reference list of five phasing classes, not a separate runtime algorithm. The linked declaration requirements preserve class identities; individual method duties remain partial.
rationale.ja: 5 phasing classの相互参照一覧で、別のruntime algorithmではない。関連する宣言要求でclassの同一性を保持し、個別methodの義務は部分扱いを保つ。

rationale.en: The two cross-references direct readers to common/runtime phase definitions. The naming/getter matrix records those classes without certifying their delegates or timing.
rationale.ja: 2つの相互参照がcommon／runtime phase定義へ案内する。名前／getter matrixでそれらのclassを記録するがdelegateやtimingは認定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction identifies classes used to specify phases and implied functionality. Linked class/descriptor/callback drafts provide the detailed selected duties; no whole-phase completion is inferred.
rationale.ja: 導入文はphaseと付随機能を規定するclassを示す。関連するclass／descriptor／callback draftが選択した詳細義務を提供し、phase全体の完了は推定しない。

rationale.en: The introduction explains the transition descriptor whose current/previous/target duties are decomposed below. It uses a callback name differing from the printed method; linked tests follow phase_state_change and retain that editorial boundary.
rationale.ja: 導入文は遷移descriptorを説明し、current／previous／targetの義務を下位で分解する。印字methodとcallback名が異なるため、関連testはphase_state_changeに従い編集上の境界を残す。

rationale.en: The implementation overview relates the master graph, IMP proxies, synchronization, thread control and jumps. Existing graph/node/proxy duties and the new synchronization/jump observations decompose selected concrete behavior. This contextual mapping does not certify every VIP composition, graph invariant or thread lifetime.
rationale.ja: 実装概要はmaster graph、IMP proxy、同期、thread制御、jumpを関連付ける。既存のgraph／node／proxy義務と新たな同期／jump観測で選択した具体動作を分解する。全VIP構成、graph不変条件、thread寿命は認定しない。

rationale.en: The base-class introduction explains reusable definitions, graph-node context/state and component-specific proxies. Linked concrete requirements retain those roles. All cloning/history and graph/lifecycle applicability conditions remain partial; no entire-class completion is inferred.
rationale.ja: base class導入は再利用定義、graph nodeのcontext／state、component固有proxyを説明する。関連する具体要求がそれらの役割を保持する。全cloning／history、graph／lifecycle適用条件は部分扱いを保ち、class全体の完了を推定しない。

rationale.en: The synchronization introduction describes the endpoint relationships added and removed by the following methods. Linked selected same/different-phase and removal duties observe those endpoints. Every topology and mutation during active phases remain partial method obligations.
rationale.ja: 同期導入は後続methodが追加／解除する両端の関係を説明する。関連する選択同名／異名phaseと解除の義務が両端を観測する。全topologyとactive phase中の変更はmethodの部分義務として残る。

rationale.en: The jumping introduction separates premature ending, next-target selection and domain-wide jumping. Those behaviors already have linked direct drafts; the new domain-wide parallel control adds a concrete active-branch condition. Invalid/unrelated targets and lifetime differences remain open rather than excluded.
rationale.ja: jump導入は早期終了、次target指定、domain全体のjumpを分ける。これらは既に関連する直接draftを持ち、新domain並行controlが具体的active分岐条件を追加する。不正／無関係targetと寿命差分は除外せず残す。

rationale.en: Chapter heading introducing factory classes; observable duties are specified in the following subclauses.
rationale.ja: factory classを導入する章見出しで、観測可能な義務は後続条項に記述する。

rationale.en: Grouping heading for component/object wrappers; the introduction and individual registry/type_id clauses carry its behavior.
rationale.ja: component／object wrapperの分類見出しで、導入と個別registry／type_id条項に動作を記述する。

rationale.en: Type/instance override heading with no independent text beyond the two following method groups.
rationale.ja: type／instance override見出しで、続く2 method群以外の独立本文を持たない。

rationale.en: Name-alias grouping heading; type and instance alias behavior follows in numbered methods.
rationale.ja: name aliasの分類見出しで、typeとinstance aliasの動作は番号付きmethodへ続く。

rationale.en: Introspection grouping heading; queries and print have their own method clauses.
rationale.ja: introspectionの分類見出しで、照会とprintは個別method条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Wrapper methods heading; creation and type-name duties appear separately below.
rationale.ja: wrapper method見出しで、生成とtype-nameの義務が下位に別々に現れる。

rationale.en: The overview describes abstract factory/proxy roles and name/type APIs, with concrete interfaces specified below. Linked wrapper/creation/declaration duties retain those roles; this does not certify every override, alias, failure or language-boundary path.
rationale.ja: 概要はabstract factory／proxyの役割とname／type APIを説明し、具体的interfaceを下位に規定する。関連するwrapper／生成／宣言義務で役割を保持するが、全override、alias、失敗、言語境界の経路は認定しない。

rationale.en: The usage section relates registration, factory-based construction and override configuration, each already specified by concrete APIs. Linked direct duties exercise selected operations; complete usage combinations and component-internal/external contexts remain partial.
rationale.ja: usage節は登録、factory経由生成、override設定を関連付け、それぞれ具体APIに既に規定する。関連する直接義務が選択操作を動かすが、全usage組合せとcomponent内部／外部contextは部分扱いに残る。

rationale.en: Memory methods grouping heading; constructor, instance configuration and relocation have separate clauses.
rationale.ja: memory methodの分類見出しで、constructor、instance設定、移動は個別条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Memory introspection grouping heading; every query has a separate numbered clause below it.
rationale.ja: memory introspectionの分類見出しで、各照会は下位に個別番号付き条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Memory HDL-access grouping heading; single, burst and direct access duties follow in individual tasks.
rationale.ja: memory HDL accessの分類見出しで、single、burst、直接access義務は個別taskへ続く。

rationale.en: Memory frontdoor grouping heading; getter and setter specify the mechanism in their own clauses.
rationale.ja: memory frontdoorの分類見出しで、getterとsetterが個別条項で機構を指定する。

rationale.en: Memory backdoor grouping heading; selection, path metadata and read/write methods follow individually.
rationale.ja: memory backdoorの分類見出しで、選択、path metadata、read／write methodが個別に続く。

rationale.en: Memory coverage grouping heading; availability, controls and sampling duties are individually specified below.
rationale.ja: memory coverageの分類見出しで、利用可能性、制御、sampling義務は下位に個別指定される。

rationale.en: Memory callbacks grouping heading; pre/post read/write callback behavior is specified by each following method.
rationale.ja: memory callbackの分類見出しで、pre／post read／write callback動作は続く各methodが指定する。

rationale.en: Types/enumerations grouping heading; concrete types and enum behavior follow in numbered clauses.
rationale.ja: 型／列挙の分類見出しで、具体型とenum動作は番号付き条項へ続く。

rationale.en: Field-automation type grouping heading; type declarations, operation meanings and flags are specified below.
rationale.ja: field-automation型の分類見出しで、型宣言、操作意味、flagは下位に記述する。

rationale.en: Reporting type grouping heading; severity/action/verbosity semantics are specified individually.
rationale.ja: reporting型の分類見出しで、severity／action／verbosity意味は個別に記述する。

rationale.en: Sequence enumeration grouping heading; arbitration/state/library meanings follow individually.
rationale.ja: sequence列挙の分類見出しで、arbitration／state／library意味は個別に続く。

rationale.en: Phasing enumeration grouping heading; phase types, lifecycle states and wait operators have separate clauses.
rationale.ja: phasing列挙の分類見出しで、phase型、lifecycle state、wait演算子は個別条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Package-method grouping heading; simulation/reporting/miscellaneous method duties follow below.
rationale.ja: package-methodの分類見出しで、simulation／reporting／miscellaneous method義務は下位へ続く。

rationale.en: Simulation-control grouping heading; state query, run and initialization are independently specified.
rationale.ja: simulation制御の分類見出しで、state照会、run、初期化は独立に記述する。

rationale.en: Global-reporting grouping heading; accessor, enable query and reporting functions have concrete specifications below.
rationale.ja: global-reportingの分類見出しで、accessor、enable照会、reporting関数は下位に具体仕様を持つ。

rationale.en: Miscellaneous grouping heading; string matching and splitting are specified in their own methods.
rationale.ja: miscellaneousの分類見出しで、文字列matchとsplitは個別methodで記述する。

rationale.en: Run-test callback methods grouping heading; naming, hooks and membership each have method clauses.
rationale.ja: run-test callback methodの分類見出しで、名前、hook、所属は各method条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Root common-methods grouping heading; singleton constructor and accessor have separate clauses.
rationale.ja: root共通methodの分類見出しで、singleton constructorとaccessorは個別条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Root simulation-control grouping heading; run, abort, timeout, finish control and elaboration checks are independently specified.
rationale.ja: root simulation制御の分類見出しで、run、abort、timeout、finish制御、elaboration検査は独立に記述する。

rationale.en: Root topology-method grouping heading; find/find_all and topology printing follow individually.
rationale.ja: root topology methodの分類見出しで、find／find_allとtopology印字は個別に続く。

rationale.en: Introduction identifies the notification callback role. Its begin/end hooks and registration are independently specified and linked; all reentrancy/order/abort conditions remain partial.
rationale.ja: 導入は通知callbackの役割を示す。begin／end hookと登録は独立に記述して関連付け、全再入／順序／abort条件は部分的に残す。

rationale.en: Annex title grouping configuration and resource classes; operational duties follow in its subclauses.
rationale.ja: configuration／resource classをまとめる付録題名で、操作義務は下位条項へ続く。

rationale.en: Resource-class grouping heading; the introduction and individual resource/pool/container clauses carry behavior.
rationale.ja: resource classの分類見出しで、動作は導入と個別resource／pool／container条項にある。

rationale.en: Resource-base common-methods heading; constructor and type-hook duties are separately numbered.
rationale.ja: resource-base共通method見出しで、constructorとtype hook義務は別番号である。

rationale.en: Read-only interface heading; setter and query behavior are specified below.
rationale.ja: read-only interface見出しで、setterと照会動作は下位に記述する。

rationale.en: Pool common-methods heading; constructor and default accessor are separately specified.
rationale.ja: pool共通method見出しで、constructorと既定accessorは別に記述する。

rationale.en: Resource-database grouping heading; introduction, parameterized declaration and convenience APIs follow.
rationale.ja: resource-databaseの分類見出しで、導入、parameter宣言、便利APIが続く。

rationale.en: Resource-DB methods heading; each static operation has an individual clause.
rationale.ja: resource-DB method見出しで、各static操作は個別条項を持つ。

rationale.en: Configuration-database grouping heading; the introduction and config API clauses contain its behavior.
rationale.ja: configuration-databaseの分類見出しで、動作は導入とconfig API条項にある。

rationale.en: Config methods heading; set/get/exists/wait operations are specified individually.
rationale.ja: config method見出しで、set／get／exists／wait操作は個別に記述する。

rationale.en: Config convenience-types heading; four concrete typedefs follow.
rationale.ja: config便利type見出しで、4個の具体typedefが続く。

rationale.en: Namespace introduction for resource types; queue and priority semantics are specified by their definitions and concrete pool APIs. Selected exact alias and priority duties are linked without certifying every API.
rationale.ja: resource type namespaceの導入で、queue／priority意味は定義と具体pool APIで記述する。選択した正確なaliasとpriority義務を関連付け、全APIを認定しない。

rationale.en: Convenience-layer introduction relates direct resources to DB operations; linked create/read/write duties exercise selected routes without duplicating each method or completing every condition.
rationale.ja: 便利layer導入は直接resourceとDB操作を関連付け、関連する生成／read／write義務で選択経路を動かす。各methodを重複化せず、全条件を完了しない。

rationale.en: The annex introduces macros/defines across reporting, object, sequence, TLM and register/version sizing. It adds no universal macro execution contract here; linked sequence duties represent one role, while child contracts remain separate.
rationale.ja: 付録導入はreport、object、sequence、TLM、register／version sizingのmacro／defineを紹介する。ここに普遍macro実行契約を加えず、関連sequence義務は1役割を表し、下位契約は別に残す。

rationale.en: This is the sequence-related macro grouping heading; action, library and sequencer-subtype contracts follow in separately numbered clauses.
rationale.ja: sequence関連macroの分類見出しで、action、library、sequencer-subtype契約は個別番号の下位条項に続く。

rationale.en: The introduction describes creating/starting sequences and items; the individual action macros define the actual create, randomize and start/finish ordering. Linked existing duties retain their individual conditions.
rationale.ja: 導入はsequence／itemの生成／開始を説明し、実際のcreate、randomize、start／finish順は個別action macroが定義する。既存関連義務の個別条件を保持する。

rationale.en: This is the sequence-library macro heading, followed by the static-registration and required library-utils invocation clauses.
rationale.ja: sequence-library macro見出しで、static登録と必須library-utils呼出し条項が続く。

rationale.en: Normative annex title grouping test sequences; individual classes and methods supply their contracts.
rationale.ja: test sequenceをまとめる規範付録の題名で、個別class／methodが契約を与える。

rationale.en: Reset-sequence methods heading, followed by separately numbered constructor and body.
rationale.ja: reset-sequence method見出しで、別番号のconstructor／bodyが続く。

rationale.en: Bit-bash wrapper variables heading; model and protected child follow individually.
rationale.ja: bit-bash wrapper変数見出しで、modelとprotected childが個別に続く。

rationale.en: Bit-bash wrapper methods heading; constructor and body are separately specified.
rationale.ja: bit-bash wrapper method見出しで、constructor／bodyは別に記述する。

rationale.en: Register-access wrapper variables heading with separately numbered model and child.
rationale.ja: register-access wrapper変数見出しで、model／childは別番号である。

rationale.en: Register-access wrapper methods heading followed by constructor and body.
rationale.ja: register-access wrapper method見出しで、constructor／bodyが続く。
